motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Check box and habit chip fill, greeting fade.

motion.name: panel
motion.purpose: Calendar fold and day panel, ring check draw.

components.name: Check box
components.description: 20pt rounded square; fills blueberry, then the tick draws.
components.css: .ds-check { display:inline-flex; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:6px; border:1.5px solid #C9CCD3; margin-right:12px; box-sizing:border-box; transition: background .16s, border-color .16s; } .ds-check-on { background:#4A55C9; border-color:#4A55C9; } .ds-check:active { transform: scale(.92); }

components.name: Habit chip
components.description: Round chip at 14% tone; fills with the tone when the habit is done.
components.css: .ds-habit { display:inline-block; width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:#3E8A9324; margin-right:12px; transition: background .16s; } .ds-habit-on { background:#3E8A93; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: 36pt pill; field when off, ink when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { height:36px; padding:0 16px; border-radius:999px; border:none; background:#F3F4F6; color:#1C1D21; font: 500 15px SUIT, sans-serif; margin-right:8px; } .ds-chip-on { background:#1C1D21; color:#fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4A55C9; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary button
components.description: 50pt blueberry button for the one main action.
components.css: .ds-btn { height:50px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:14px; border:none; background:#4A55C9; color:#fff; font: 600 17px SUIT, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:active { opacity:.7; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1C1D21; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: 흰 종이 위 글자와 머리카락 선만으로 구조를 세운다. 카드·그림자·색 면이 없고, 색은 체크 상자와 습관 칩이 완료될 때만 들어온다.

rules.name: Color only on completion
rules.body: Large color areas appear only when a check box or habit chip is done.

dos: Do separate groups with section headers and hairlines.
Do add icons as SF Symbols in ICONS.
donts: Don't bring back cards, shadow boxes, filled summary panels, or confetti.
